limitations: This selectable spreadsheet mapping measures complete RFC1950 zlib / RFC1951 DEFLATE, including LZ77 matching, Huffman coding and Adler32. It does not measure a standalone pure LZ77 token stream or isolated matching time.

lz77 and deflate-zlib resolve to exactly the same AlgorithmID, SourceArtifactID, ConfigID, execution path and comparison keys; selecting both names generates one task per unique canonical configuration, not two ranked algorithms.

No alternative yalz77/misa77 implementation is silently substituted for the spreadsheet's zlib source. A future pure LZ77 variant requires separate user-approved source/format admission and explicit P0/P1/P2 contracts.
Existing deflate-zlib parameter, lifecycle, capacity and resource limits apply unchanged; unsupported dictionary, query, streaming, raw-DEFLATE/gzip and multithread modes are not added.
